mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_delivery (order_id, order_no, package_no, express_code, express_name, tracking_number, delivery_type, delivery_time, remark, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{packageNo}, #{expressCode}, #{expressName}, #{trackingNumber}, #{deliveryType}, #{deliveryTime}, #{remark}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, order_no, package_no, express_code, express_name, tracking_number, delivery_type, delivery_time, remark, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM order_delivery WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, order_id, order_no, package_no, express_code, express_name, tracking_number, delivery_type, delivery_time, remark, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM order_delivery WHERE package_no = #{packageNo} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, order_id, order_no, package_no, express_code, express_name, tracking_number, delivery_type, delivery_time, remark, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM order_delivery WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY delivery_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE order_delivery SET express_code = #{expressCode}, express_name = #{expressName}, tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
